3034.title: Claude sandbox omits user writable paths when bb adds roots
3034.rootCauseOneLine: The provider builds the SDK sandbox writable-path array solely from bb's additional roots, so user settings are absent from the explicit sandbox configuration.
3034.proposedFix: Parse enabled Claude settings at the provider boundary and merge their validated sandbox policy with bb's additional roots while preserving restrictive-field precedence.
3034.caveats: No authenticated provider turn was run; the deterministic omission was reproduced before provider launch in two clean checkouts.
